messages:
Ava Hu: Quick q — when auto-fallback triggers for latency we currently switch to a smaller model variant and emit an audit event. How long do we keep the full decision trace? We need it for postmortems but retention impacts storage/console perf.
Rohit Gupta: We currently retain 30d by default in traces table. Ops asked for 90d for enterprise. But that's heavy; maybe sample 1% for high-traffic routes? :thinking_face: 
Maya Lee: For rollout UX, I'd prefer a per-route policy: full trace for canaries, sampled for stable. UI should expose sampling rate and effective retention (clear callout).
Priya N.: Agree. Also need to surface why fallback chose a variant — show metrics: latency, error rate, capacity breaches. Inline reason helps SRE debugging.
Ava Hu: Mockup idea: in rollout panel -> "Fallback behavior" card shows current policy, sample rate, last N fallback events, with ability to download trace. Sketch: 

```
fallback_policy: {\n  trigger: \"latency_p95>800ms\",\n  mode: \"model_variant\",\n  variant: \"mosaic-7b-quant\",\n  sampling: { rate: 0.05, priority: \"canary\" },\n  retention_days: 90\n}\n```

Rohit Gupta: That looks good. Two questions: 1) do we support multiple triggers (latency + error spike)? 2) when fallback happens do we backfill KV cache concerns?
Maya Lee: Yes multi-trigger needed. And backfill — we should warm KV cache for the variant asynchronously; otherwise cold starts cause more fallbacks.
Priya N.: UX: Add a toggle "require manual review before widening fallback" — helps product owners during canary.
ops-bot: [auto] Fallback rule created for route /chat/stream by rohit.g (id: fr-20270316-004)
Ava Hu: For telemetry storage, proposal: keep full traces for 30d global, enterprise customers can opt-in for 90d, and we store aggregated telemetry (counts, p95, fallback_rate) indefinitely. Export S3 option for raw traces.
Rohit Gupta: Implementation note: add flags to /v1/policies API: sampling.rate, retention_days, export_s3_bucket. Need schema validation and migration plan.
Maya Lee: UI copy: "When auto-fallback occurs, we store a decision trace explaining the trigger and actions. You can change retention and sampling per route."
Priya N.: Let's add a tiny CTA in the rollout flow: 'Test policy' which runs 100 simulated requests and shows how many would fallback.
Ava Hu: +1. That simulation will be crucial for product adoption. I'll add to design doc.
Rohit Gupta: I'll stub API and a telemetry migration plan. Follow-up: sync tomorrow 10am PT?
Maya Lee: yep
Priya N.: :+1:
